title: Marriage
definition: Marriage is the covenant relationship established by God between one man and one woman, designed to reflect His purposes, provide companionship, and glorify Him through faithful commitment.
summary: Marriage is not merely a social arrangement or legal contract; it is a covenant established by God. Scripture presents marriage as a lifelong union built upon love, faithfulness, sacrifice, service, and mutual commitment. Though every marriage faces challenges because of sin and human weakness, God's design provides a framework for growth, unity, and glorifying Him together. Healthy marriages require continual dependence upon Christ, communication, forgiveness, humility, and intentional love.
christFocus: Marriage ultimately points to the relationship between Christ and His Church, revealing His covenant love, faithfulness, sacrifice, and care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Marriage affects families, churches, communities, and future generations. Understanding God's design helps believers pursue healthy, Christ-centered relationships rather than relying solely on cultural ideas about marriage.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: View your marriage as a ministry rather than merely a relationship. Seek opportunities to serve, encourage, forgive, and strengthen your spouse. Ask regularly how you can reflect Christ's love more faithfully within your marriage.
